name: Hampi (Group of Monuments at Vijayanagara)
description: Spectacular 4,100-hectare boulder-strewn capital city featuring over 1,600 surviving monuments, palaces, and hydraulic royal baths.
history: The capital of the Vijayanagara Empire, described by Portuguese and Persian visitors as one of the richest metropolises in the world.
construction: Engineered with local granite boulders, sophisticated aqueducts, and chariot shrines.
architecture: Features the Virupaksha Temple, the stone chariot of the Vittala Temple with musical pillars, and the Lotus Mahal.
currentStatus: Preserved archaeological complex in Bellary District, Karnataka, India.
